statement: Replica-operation ownership becomes durable and fenced: owner identity with a lease is persisted (the schema's vestigial lease_expires_at column is the foothold — today it is never read or written), orphaned operations on ordinary partitions get adopted by a fenced successor instead of never being resumed, priority-control-plane drain remote-settlement stops relying on the unfenced routing-readiness heuristic, and shutdown joins in-flight work — a bounded await of in-flight lanes plus a fence bump — instead of flag-set + map-clear while continuations past an await proceed unguarded. Verified-audit findings 5 and 14. Sequenced after Tier 1/2: the terminal CAS (replica-operation-terminal-cas) removes the worst consequence of duplicate owners in the meantime. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/operation-ownership-lease-fencing.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — durable-owner-lease-enforced, orphan-op-adopted-by-fenced-successor, and shutdown-joins-in-flight receipts passing (deterministic red-on-revert evidence harness).

constraints.statement: Each new regression test must fail when the lease/fence or the shutdown-join is reverted while the rest of the change remains.
Do not start before replica-operation-terminal-cas lands; Tier-1/Tier-2 fixes remove the worst duplicate-owner consequences first and this Quest must not re-open them.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
